item.title: Woodland Christian boys basketball team beats SLD foe Highlands, capping off senior night in style
item.description: On Friday night, on what just happened to be the team's Senior Night, the Woodland Christian boys basketball team put some much-needed distance between them and the Sierra Delta League's third-place team, Highlands, defeating them in a low-scoring battle 53-34 Friday night at Jack Hamlin Gym.

item.title: Woodland Christian girls basketball team celebrates senior night with huge SLD win over Highlands
item.description: Despite bringing in a 19-2 record and while being undefeated in Sierra Delta League play, the Woodland Christian girls basketball team still has a few things to cross off on its regular-season wish list. Among the items left were running the table to go 12-0 the league and hopefully win big on the team's Senior Night.

item.title: Tribes express ‘serious concern’ over Vallejo casino
item.description: However, the larger casino is still in limbo with Judge Trevor McFadden of the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia rejecting Scotts Valley’s efforts to invalidate the reconsideration process in October. The same week, the Department of the Interior acknowledged that its original approval of the proposed casino may have been based on “legal error."
